concept_options.title: Freeze the selection before the chamber
concept_options.hook: Five SPY candidates stop before later prices open.
concept_options.visual_approach: Open evidence rails, a physical seal, and sentence-bound probes that trace the decision mechanism.
concept_options.target_audience: A curious beginner who can read a number but does not yet know why a later block has to be sealed.
concept_options.cta: Ask about fill timing and trading hours.
concept_options.why_this_works: It turns the evidence boundary into a physical mechanism and keeps SPY and Dow as separate lanes.

concept_options.title: One Dow identity, two price windows
concept_options.hook: The candidate stays the same while the measured result changes.
concept_options.visual_approach: A moving candidate marker crosses two chronological rails.
concept_options.target_audience: A curious beginner who can read a number but does not yet know why a later block has to be sealed.
concept_options.core_message: Same row does not mean same evidence status.
concept_options.cta: Ask what execution fields remain open.
concept_options.why_this_works: It gives the Dow contrast a single visible identity without allowing it to stand in for SPY.

concept_options.title: Read the gate as an operator
concept_options.hook: A number needs an operator, a threshold, and a unit.
concept_options.visual_approach: Three rails compare actual values to thresholds one row at a time.
concept_options.target_audience: A curious beginner who can read a number but does not yet know why a later block has to be sealed.
concept_options.core_message: Do not turn an unlabelled number into a verdict.
concept_options.cta: Ask whether the data and execution are fully specified.
concept_options.why_this_works: It makes the worked operators visible and prevents the lesson from collapsing into verdict colors.

selected_concept.rationale: The operator direction requires SPY 5→0 and a sealed later-price chamber, while the separate Dow lane must remain visible without becoming the SPY result.
modifications: Replace the repeated bordered stage shell with an open canvas.
Replace paired rounded cards in scenes 08 and 14 with rails and a branching question path.
Bind a real motion probe and mechanism transformation to every sentence cue in the final timeline.

stages.approach: Reconcile the live series authority and E02 scope before generation.

quality_tradeoffs.quality_impact: Preserves evidence clarity and the current series audio route.

production_plan.art_direction: Open near-black canvas, paper-white evidence, amber untouched state, cyan measurement path, magenta seal; rails and mechanical probes replace rounded cards.

taste_profile.reference_strategy: Native frames are reviewed at 150px squint and in a playable montage.
